violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DR upright, right side cooler: marinara sauce (46f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 2DR upright, right side cooler
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. REPAIR OR REPLACE THIS COOLER BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. DO NOT USE THIS COOLER TO STORE TCS FOODS (ie: TOMATO SAUCE, BEANS, SALAD, MILK, CHEESE) UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed a missing ceiling tiles above the mop sink
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. REPLACE CEILING TILE BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: Observed an unlabeled spray bottle full of water on the prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC DISCARDED THE SPRAY BOTTLE. PLEASE LABEL ALL FOOD AND WATER STORAGE CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Room, Kept Closed
violations.observation: Observed the staff toilet/locker room door propped open at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Keep toilet room doors closed to prevent insect and rodent entrance and the associated spread of potential disease. PIC CLOSED THE TOILET/LOCKER ROOM DOOR.
